meta.notes: A statistic: a number counted for each player, shown in the Statistics screen and saved with the world. "formatter" says how it is shown: default (a plain number), distance (centimetres shown as metres and kilometres) or time (ticks shown as seconds, minutes, hours and days). A scoreboard objective follows it with the criterion minecraft.custom:msm_examples.bells_rung. A rule adds to it with "Add to a statistic" and checks it with "The statistic is at least". It needs the Fabric mod jar export; the vanilla packs keep only its models, pictures and language keys.
